---
title: "Claustrum Connectivity in Prematurity GLM analyses"
author: "Jil Wendt"
format: html
editor: visual
---

GLMs in preterm-born adults (BLS cohort): early environment, perinatal variables, cognition at 8 years (K-ABC) and adult cognition, and group x environment interactions in the full cohort. Heatmap panels for Figures 4, 5 and S4.

- Input: `data/adults_harmonized.csv`
- Outputs:
  - `outputs/tables/CP_Early_FULL_FACTOR_SES_<date>.csv`: Table S14 (results/env_GLM_CP_BLS.csv)
  - `outputs/tables/CP_Interaction_GroupxAllEnv_<date>.csv`: Table S15 (results/env_interaction_group_x_env_CP_BLS.csv)
  - `outputs/tables/CP_Prematurity_single_GLM_PTonly_NEW<date>.csv`: Table S9 (results/perinatal_GLM_CP_BLS.csv)
  - `outputs/tables/CP_cognitive8y_single_GLM_PTonly_<date>.csv` (results/cognition_KABC_GLM_CP_BLS.csv)
  - `outputs/tables/Cognition_singleROI_CP_PTonly_<date>.csv`: Table S17 (results/cognition_GLM_CP_BLS.csv)
  - `outputs/figures/p_heat_*_BLS_noleg.rds`: heatmap panels, combined in `manuscript_figures.qmd`
  - `checkpoints/glm_checkpoint.rds`: input for `Revision_2_1_3.qmd`

# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(here)

tab_dir <- here::here("outputs", "tables")
```

#### Helper Functions

```{r}
theme_claustrum_heatmap <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid      = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x    = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y    = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
                                     margin = margin(t = 4)),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(margin = margin(r = 4)),
      legend.title    = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      plot.margin     = margin(t = 5.5, r = 5.5, b = 5.5, l = 5.5)
    )
}
```

## Load data

```{r}
dat <- read_delim(
  here("data", "adults_harmonized.csv"),
  delim = ";",
  trim_ws = TRUE,
  locale = locale(decimal_mark = ","),
  na = c(""," ","NA", "NaN", "n/a", ".", "-9999","999"),
  col_types = cols(
    Subject = col_character(),
    ID      = col_character()
  ),
  guess_max = 10000
) |> janitor::clean_names()

# --- recode and name important factors ---
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(case_when(
      groupcode == 0 ~ "FT",
      groupcode == 1 ~ "PT",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("FT", "PT")),

    sex = factor(case_when(
      sex == 1 ~ "Male",
      sex == 2 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  )
```

```{r}
# ROIs with FDR-significant group differences in CP
sig_roi_codes <- c(
  "cp_ac_occ_r_ipsi",
  "cp_ac_occ_l_ipsi",
  "cp_ac_par_l_ipsi",
  "cp_ac_pfc_l_ipsi",
  "cp_ac_temp_l_ipsi",
  "cp_pc_mot_r_ipsi",
  "cp_pc_vis_r_ipsi",
  "cp_c_pos_r_ipsi"
)
```

## Find discrete variables

```{r}
find_discrete_candidates <- function(data, max_unique = 10) {
  data %>%
    summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ list(unique(.)))) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      everything(),
      names_to = "variable",
      values_to = "unique_values"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      n_unique = purrr::map_int(unique_values, length),
      sample_values = purrr::map_chr(unique_values, ~ paste(sort(.x), collapse = ", "))
    ) %>%
    filter(n_unique <= max_unique) %>%
    dplyr::select(variable, n_unique, sample_values) %>%
    arrange(n_unique)
}
```

### Recoding variables as discrete

```{r}
cands <- find_discrete_candidates(dat, max_unique = 11) |>
  dplyr::pull(variable)

dat <- dat |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(cands) & where(~ !is.factor(.)),
      ~ factor(.x, levels = sort(unique(.x)))
    )
  )
```

## Adjust data and create subsets

```{r}
drop_vars <- c("id")

final_dat_CP <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("cd_"), -all_of(drop_vars))

cp_vars    <- grep("^cp_", names(final_dat_CP), value = TRUE)
early_vars <- c("ses0y2", "psi1", "betreu", "optws")

dat_PT <- final_dat_CP %>%
  dplyr::filter(group == "PT")
```

# Analysis 1: Early Social Environment

### Specific setup

```{r}
covars <- c("age_at_scan", "sex")

stopifnot(all(c(early_vars, covars) %in% names(dat_PT)))
```

### SES as factor

```{r}
dat_PT_fac <- dat_PT %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(c(cp_vars, "psi1", "betreu", "optws")), ~ {
      if (is.factor(.)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.))) else as.numeric(.)
    }),
    ses0y2_fac = factor(ses0y2, levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                        labels = c("Upper", "Middle", "Lower"))
  )
```

#### Full model: CP \~ SES (factor) + PIRI + PSI + pregnancy optimality + age + sex

```{r}
results_full_factorSES <- map_dfr(cp_vars, function(dv) {
  fml <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~", paste(c("ses0y2_fac", "psi1", "betreu", "optws", covars), collapse = " + ")))
  df  <- dat_PT_fac[, all.vars(fml)] %>% na.omit()
  if (nrow(df) < 5) return(NULL)

  fit <- lm(fml, data = df)
  td  <- tidy(fit); gl <- glance(fit)

  td %>% 
    filter(grepl("^ses0y2_fac", term) | term %in% c("psi1","betreu","optws")) %>%
    transmute(
      model_type    = "full_factorSES",
      predictor_or_contrast = term,
      dv            = dv,
      estimate      = estimate,
      std.error     = std.error,
      ci_lo         = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
      ci_hi         = estimate + 1.96 * std.error,
      t_value       = statistic,
      p.value       = p.value,
      r.squared     = gl$r.squared,
      adj.r.squared = gl$adj.r.squared,
      n             = nrow(df)
    )
})

# FDR across all predictors and ROIs
results_full_factorSES <- results_full_factorSES %>%
  mutate(p_adj_fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  arrange(p_adj_fdr, p.value)

# FDR within each predictor across ROIs
results_full_factorSES <- results_full_factorSES %>%
  group_by(predictor_or_contrast) %>%
  mutate(p_adj_fdr_by_predictor = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup()

outfile_full_fac <- file.path(tab_dir, paste0("CP_Early_FULL_FACTOR_SES_", format(Sys.Date()), ".csv"))
write_csv2(results_full_factorSES, outfile_full_fac)
message("Saved: ", outfile_full_fac)
```

#### Interaction analysis: group x environmental factors (full cohort)

```{r}
dat_full_fac <- final_dat_CP %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(c(cp_vars, "psi1", "betreu", "optws")), ~ {
      if (is.factor(.)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.))) else as.numeric(.)
    }),
    ses0y2_fac = factor(ses0y2, levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                        labels = c("Upper", "Middle", "Lower")),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("FT", "PT"))
  )
```

```{r}
env_vars_interaction <- list(
  list(pred = "ses0y2_fac", interact_term = "group * ses0y2_fac",  filter_pattern = "groupPT:ses0y2_fac"),
  list(pred = "psi1",       interact_term = "group * psi1",        filter_pattern = "groupPT:psi1"),
  list(pred = "betreu",     interact_term = "group * betreu",       filter_pattern = "groupPT:betreu"),
  list(pred = "optws",      interact_term = "group * optws",        filter_pattern = "groupPT:optws")
)

results_interaction_all <- map_dfr(env_vars_interaction, function(env) {
  map_dfr(cp_vars, function(dv) {
    
    other_env <- setdiff(c("ses0y2_fac", "psi1", "betreu", "optws"), env$pred)
    
    fml <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~", paste(c(env$interact_term, other_env, covars), collapse = " + ")))
    df  <- dat_full_fac[, all.vars(fml)] %>% na.omit()
    if (nrow(df) < 5) return(NULL)
    
    fit <- lm(fml, data = df)
    td  <- tidy(fit); gl <- glance(fit)
    
    td %>%
      filter(grepl(env$filter_pattern, term)) %>%
      transmute(
        model_type            = paste0("interaction_groupx", env$pred),
        predictor_or_contrast = term,
        dv                    = dv,
        estimate              = estimate,
        std.error             = std.error,
        ci_lo                 = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
        ci_hi                 = estimate + 1.96 * std.error,
        t_value               = statistic,
        p.value               = p.value,
        r.squared             = gl$r.squared,
        adj.r.squared         = gl$adj.r.squared,
        n                     = nrow(df)
      )
  })
})

results_interaction_all <- results_interaction_all %>%
  mutate(p_adj_fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  arrange(p_adj_fdr, p.value) %>%
  group_by(predictor_or_contrast) %>%
  mutate(p_adj_fdr_by_predictor = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup()

outfile_interaction_all <- file.path(tab_dir, paste0("CP_Interaction_GroupxAllEnv_", format(Sys.Date()), ".csv"))
write_csv2(results_interaction_all, outfile_interaction_all)
message("Saved: ", outfile_interaction_all)
```

### Heatmap (Figure 4B)

```{r}
labels_map <- c(
  betreu           = "PIRI\n(neo/5m)",
  psi1             = "Psychosocial Stress Index\n(neo/5m)",
  optws            = "Optimality pregnancy",
  ses0y2_fac1      = "SES:\nLower vs Upper",
  ses0y2_fac2      = "SES:\nMiddle vs Upper",
  ses0y2_facMiddle = "SES:\nMiddle vs Upper",
  ses0y2_facLower  = "SES:\nLower vs Upper"
)

pred_order_keys <- c("betreu","psi1","optws",
                     "ses0y2_fac1","ses0y2_fac2",
                     "ses0y2_facMiddle","ses0y2_facLower")

sig_roi_labels <- unname(roi_labels[sig_roi_codes])

heat_df <- results_full_factorSES %>%
  mutate(
    ROI      = dplyr::recode(dv, !!!roi_labels, .default = dv),
    term_chr = as.character(predictor_or_contrast),
    predictor_label = {
      m <- labels_map[term_chr]
      m[is.na(m)] <- term_chr[is.na(m)]
      unname(m)
    },
    neglog10p = -log10(p.value) * sign(estimate),
    sig_unc   = p.value < 0.05,
    sig_fdr   = if ("p_adj_fdr_by_predictor" %in% names(.)) p_adj_fdr_by_predictor < 0.05 else FALSE,
    sig_type  = factor(
      dplyr::case_when(
        sig_fdr ~ "FDR < .05",
        sig_unc ~ "p < .05 (uncorr.)",
        TRUE    ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = sig_levels
    )
  )

present_keys  <- intersect(pred_order_keys, unique(results_full_factorSES$predictor_or_contrast))
pretty_levels <- unique(na.omit(unname(labels_map[present_keys])))

heat_df <- heat_df %>%
  mutate(
    predictor_label = factor(predictor_label, levels = pretty_levels),
    ROI             = factor(ROI, levels = rev(unname(roi_labels)))
  )

dummy_sig_SES <- data.frame(
  predictor_label = factor(levels(heat_df$predictor_label)[1],
                           levels = levels(heat_df$predictor_label)),
  ROI      = factor(levels(heat_df$ROI)[1],
                    levels = levels(heat_df$ROI)),
  sig_type = factor(sig_levels, levels = sig_levels)
)

M <- 3
p_heat_full_factorSES <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = predictor_label, y = ROI, fill = neglog10p)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_point(
    data   = subset(heat_df, !is.na(sig_type)),
    aes(shape = sig_type),
    size   = 2.2,
    stroke = 0.8,
    colour = "black",
    na.rm  = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data        = dummy_sig_SES,
    aes(x = predictor_label, y = ROI, shape = sig_type),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha       = 0,
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
 scale_shape_manual(
    name   = "Significance",
    values = c("p < .05 (uncorr.)" = 1,
               "FDR < .05"         = 16),
    breaks = sig_levels,
    drop   = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    name = "Sign & strength\n(–log10 p)",
    low = "#4575B4", mid = "white", high = "#D73027",
    limits = c(-M, M), midpoint = 0, oob = scales::squish
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(rois) ifelse(
      rois %in% sig_roi_labels,
      paste0("★ ", rois),
      rois
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x       = NULL,
    y       = NULL,
    caption = "★ Region with significant PT vs. FT group difference in CP"
  ) +
  theme_claustrum_heatmap() +
  theme(
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9, colour = "grey30",
                                margin = margin(t = 6))
  ) +
  guides(
    fill  = guide_colourbar(order = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(order = 2)
  )

p_heat_full_factorSES_BLS_noleg <- p_heat_full_factorSES +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  guides(
    fill  = "none",
    shape = "none"
  )

saveRDS(p_heat_full_factorSES_BLS_noleg, here("outputs", "figures", "p_heat_full_factorSES_BLS_noleg.rds"))
```

# Analysis 2: Perinatal variables

### Setup

```{r}
prematurity_vars <- c("tz", "gew", "inti")

dat_PT_num <- dat_PT %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(c(cp_vars, prematurity_vars)), ~ {
    if (is.factor(.)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.))) else as.numeric(.)
  }))
```

## GLM: CP \~ perinatal variable + age + sex (PT only)

```{r}
results_prematurity <- purrr::map_dfr(prematurity_vars, function(pred) {
  purrr::map_dfr(cp_vars, function(dv) {

    fml <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~", paste(c(pred, covars), collapse = " + ")))
    df  <- dat_PT_num[, all.vars(fml)] %>% na.omit()
    if (nrow(df) < 5) return(NULL)

    fit <- lm(fml, data = df)

    td <- tidy(fit)
    gl <- glance(fit)

    row <- td %>% filter(term == pred)
    if (!nrow(row)) return(NULL)

    tibble(
      predictor     = pred,
      dv            = dv,
      estimate      = row$estimate,
      std.error     = row$std.error,
      ci_lo         = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
      ci_hi         = estimate + 1.96 * std.error,
      t_value       = row$statistic,
      p.value       = row$p.value,
      r.squared     = gl$r.squared,
      adj.r.squared = gl$adj.r.squared,
      n             = nrow(df)
    )
  })
})

# FDR across all predictors and ROIs
results_prematurity <- results_prematurity %>%
  mutate(p_adj_fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  arrange(p.value)

# FDR within each predictor across ROIs
results_prematurity <- results_prematurity %>%
  group_by(predictor) %>%
  mutate(p_adj_fdr_by_predictor = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup()

outfile_prem <- file.path(tab_dir, paste0("CP_Prematurity_single_GLM_PTonly_NEW", format(Sys.Date()), ".csv"))
readr::write_csv2(results_prematurity, outfile_prem)
message("Saved: ", outfile_prem)
```

### Heatmap (Figure S4B)

```{r}
# scale BW effect to per 100 g
pred_order <- c("gew","tz","inti")
pred_labs  <- c(
  gew  = "Birth weight\n(per 100 g)",
  tz   = "Gestational age\n(per week)",
  inti = "INTI"
)

heat_df <- results_prematurity %>%
  mutate(
    ROI = dplyr::recode(dv, !!!roi_labels, .default = dv),
    estimate_scaled  = if_else(predictor == "gew", estimate * 100, estimate),
    std.error_scaled = if_else(predictor == "gew", std.error * 100, std.error),
    predictor_label = {
      mapped <- pred_labs[predictor]
      mapped[is.na(mapped)] <- predictor[is.na(mapped)]
      unname(mapped)
    },
    # signed -log10(p): red = positive, blue = negative
    neglog10p = -log10(p.value) * sign(estimate_scaled),

    # significance flags
    sig_unc   = p.value < 0.05,
    sig_fdr_p = if ("p_adj_fdr_by_predictor" %in% names(.)) p_adj_fdr_by_predictor < 0.05 else FALSE,

    # combined significance type for the legend
    sig_type  = factor(
      dplyr::case_when(
        sig_fdr_p ~ "FDR < .05",
        sig_unc   ~ "p < .05 (uncorr.)",
        TRUE      ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = sig_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    predictor_label = factor(predictor_label, levels = pred_labs[pred_order]),
    ROI             = factor(ROI, levels = rev(unname(roi_labels)))
  )

dummy_sig_prem <- data.frame(
  predictor_label = factor(levels(heat_df$predictor_label)[1],
                           levels = levels(heat_df$predictor_label)),
  ROI      = factor(levels(heat_df$ROI)[1],
                    levels = levels(heat_df$ROI)),
  sig_type = factor(sig_levels, levels = sig_levels)
)

p_heat <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = predictor_label, y = ROI, fill = neglog10p)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_point(
    data   = subset(heat_df, !is.na(sig_type)),
    aes(shape = sig_type),
    size   = 2.2,
    stroke = 0.8,
    colour = "black",
    na.rm  = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data        = dummy_sig_prem,
    aes(x = predictor_label, y = ROI, shape = sig_type),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha       = 0,
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name   = "Significance",
    values = c("p < .05 (uncorr.)" = 1,
               "FDR < .05"         = 16),
    breaks = sig_levels,
    drop   = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    name = "Sign & strength\n(-log10 p)",
    low = "#4575B4", mid = "white", high = "#D73027",
    limits = c(-3, 3), midpoint = 0, oob = scales::squish
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(rois) ifelse(
      rois %in% sig_roi_labels,
      paste0("★ ", rois),
      rois
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_claustrum_heatmap() +
  guides(
    fill  = guide_colourbar(order = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(order = 2)
  )

p_heat_prem_BLS_noleg <- p_heat +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  guides(
    fill  = "none",
    shape = "none"
  )

saveRDS(p_heat_prem_BLS_noleg,
        here("outputs", "figures", "p_heat_prem_BLS_noleg.rds"))
```

      estimate      = row$estimate,
      std.error     = row$std.error,
      ci_lo         = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
      ci_hi         = estimate + 1.96 * std.error,
      t_value       = row$statistic,
      p.value       = row$p.value,
      r.squared     = gl$r.squared,
      adj.r.squared = gl$adj.r.squared,

})

# FDR across all predictors and ROIs

outfile_cog8y <- file.path(tab_dir, paste0("CP_cognitive8y_single_GLM_PTonly_", format(Sys.Date()), ".csv"))

# Analysis 4: Adult cognition

### Setup

CP z-scored within the PT group.

```{r}
cog_vars_fsiq   <- c("wie_gesiq")
cog_vars_ant    <- c("ant_alerting","ant_orienting","ant_congruency")

cog_all <- c(cog_vars_fsiq,
             cog_vars_ant)

dat_PT_cog <- dat_PT %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(c(cp_vars, cog_all)), ~ {
      if (is.factor(.)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.))) else as.numeric(.)
    }),
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(cp_vars), ~ as.numeric(scale(.)))
  )
```

## GLM: cognitive outcome \~ CP + age + sex (PT only)

```{r}
run_outcome_vs_each_cp <- function(outcome, family){
  map_dfr(cp_vars, function(cp_col){
    fml <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", paste(c(cp_col, covars), collapse = " + ")))
    df  <- dat_PT_cog[, all.vars(fml)] %>% na.omit()
    if (nrow(df) < 10) return(NULL)
    fit <- lm(fml, data = df); td <- tidy(fit); gl <- glance(fit)
    row <- td %>% filter(term == cp_col); if (!nrow(row)) return(NULL)
    tibble(
      family = family, outcome = outcome, dv_label = outcome,
      predictor = cp_col, estimate = row$estimate, std.error = row$std.error, ci_lo         = estimate - 1.96 * std.error, ci_hi         = estimate + 1.96 * std.error,
      t_value = row$statistic, p.value = row$p.value,
      r.squared = gl$r.squared, adj.r.squared = gl$adj.r.squared, n = nrow(df)
    )
  }) %>%
  mutate(outcome = factor(outcome)) %>%
  group_by(outcome) %>%  # FDR within outcome across ROIs
  mutate(p_adj_fdr_within_outcome = p.adjust(p.value, "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup()
}

res_single <- bind_rows(
  run_outcome_vs_each_cp("wie_gesiq", "FSIQ"),
  run_outcome_vs_each_cp("ant_alerting","ANT"),
  run_outcome_vs_each_cp("ant_orienting","ANT"),
  run_outcome_vs_each_cp("ant_congruency","ANT"),
) %>% arrange(outcome, p_adj_fdr_within_outcome, p.value)

write_csv2(res_single, file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Cognition_singleROI_CP_PTonly_", format(Sys.Date()), ".csv")))
```

### Heatmap (Figure 5B)

```{r}
outcome_order <- c(
  "wie_gesiq",
  "ant_alerting","ant_orienting","ant_congruency"
)
outcome_labs <- c(
  wie_gesiq      = "FSIQ",
  ant_alerting   = "ANT:\nAlerting",
  ant_orienting  = "ANT:\nOrienting",
  ant_congruency = "ANT:\nCongruency"
)

heat_cog <- res_single %>%
  mutate(
    ROI = dplyr::recode(predictor, !!!roi_labels, .default = predictor),
    Outcome = factor(
      as.character(outcome),
      levels = outcome_order,
      labels = outcome_labs[outcome_order]
    ),
    neglog10p = -log10(p.value) * sign(estimate),
    sig_unc   = p.value < 0.05,
    sig_fdr   = p_adj_fdr_within_outcome < 0.05,
    sig_type  = factor(
      dplyr::case_when(
        sig_fdr ~ "FDR < .05",
        sig_unc ~ "p < .05 (uncorr.)",
        TRUE    ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = sig_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(ROI = factor(ROI, levels = rev(unname(roi_labels))))

dummy_sig_cog <- data.frame(
  Outcome = factor(levels(heat_cog$Outcome)[1],
                   levels = levels(heat_cog$Outcome)),
  ROI      = factor(levels(heat_cog$ROI)[1],
                    levels = levels(heat_cog$ROI)),
  sig_type = factor(sig_levels, levels = sig_levels)
)

p_heat_cog <- ggplot(heat_cog, aes(x = Outcome, y = ROI, fill = neglog10p)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_point(
    data   = subset(heat_cog, !is.na(sig_type)),
    aes(shape = sig_type),
    size   = 2.2,
    stroke = 0.8,
    colour = "black",
    na.rm  = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data        = dummy_sig_cog,
    aes(x = Outcome, y = ROI, shape = sig_type),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha       = 0,
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name   = "Significance",
    values = c("p < .05 (uncorr.)" = 1,
               "FDR < .05"         = 16),
    breaks = sig_levels,
    drop   = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    name = "Sign & strength\n(-log10 p)",
    low = "#4575B4", mid = "white", high = "#D73027",
    limits = c(-3, 3), midpoint = 0, oob = scales::squish
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(rois) ifelse(
      rois %in% sig_roi_labels,
      paste0("★ ", rois),
      rois
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_claustrum_heatmap() +
  guides(
    fill  = guide_colourbar(order = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(order = 2)
  )

p_heat_cog_BLS_noleg <- p_heat_cog +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  guides(
    fill  = "none",
    shape = "none"
  )

saveRDS(p_heat_cog_BLS_noleg,
        here("outputs", "figures", "p_heat_cog_BLS_noleg.rds"))
```
